scope: Echte Frontendmodule mit isolierten Beispieldaten und simulierten Diagnose- und Zuordnungsantworten. Keine produktiven Verbindungen oder Neuladeaufträge.
checks: Device workspace has two tabs and keeps the tournament navigation
Connections, battery, surface and explicit diagnostic contact appear together
Battery graphics occupy a separate column rather than the device name
Device assignments have no picture previews, embedded documents or preview renderer
Battery interiors are exactly 100 pixels wide and each percent fills one pixel
Percentages and charging bolts stay inside the taller battery
Battery warning thresholds use solid red below 10 percent, yellow below 25 and green from 25
Low batteries keep their warning visible in the frame and empty track
Charging is identified by a visible inline bolt and an accessible label
Ladeanzeige verwendet das gemeinsame GIF in Originalgröße ohne CSS-Animation (100 px)
GIF bewegt den Hintergrund bei unverändertem echtem Ladestand, Prozentwert und Warnfarbe (100 px)
20 und 80 Prozent verdecken dasselbe GIF unterschiedlich lange, ohne Skalierung nach Ladestand (100 px)
Blockiertes GIF fällt sichtbar auf den echten Akkustand mit Prozentzahl und Ladeblitz zurück (100 px)
Unchanged device polling preserves the shared charging GIF and its existing element
Unplugging stops the animation immediately at the real battery level
Reduced motion disables the charging animation while preserving the charge indication
Devices without battery information show an unknown level rather than an empty battery
Remaining time appears below the graphic using the reported charge and discharge times
Battery estimates select full charge, warning and reserve at the correct thresholds
Missing, infinite, zero and invalid reported times do not produce invented estimates
Changed time estimates update without restarting the charging animation or replacing their label
Offline devices do not show a current time estimate
Empty, fractional and full battery updates retain the graphic and fill the correct pixel count
Empty and full charging batteries keep the percentage and bolt inside the outline
A full battery keeps the charging bolt without running an empty animation
Invalid battery readings remain unavailable without producing overflowing fills
A legacy page label does not associate browser logs with a protocol-only device
Tablet and display contacts appear without a matching browser page, scoped to their tournament
Existing display ACK timestamps count as contact even before a protocol snapshot arrives
The newest browser or protocol contact wins and devices without either remain unknown
Polling updates protocol contacts without replacing the device row or enabling unrelated logs
Incoming display confirmations update the visible contact immediately
Polling and live score metadata preserve focused inputs and open browser groups
A live change to available profiles preserves the focused draft selection
Profile assignment locks only its row and suppresses duplicate writes across polls
A failed assignment restores its saved value with an inline explanation
Client IDs containing underscores reach the existing assignment command intact
Court selection identifies the hall and preserves fields with duplicate numbers
A display profile for several courts retains its server-provided assignment
Offline assignments remain editable and removal is restricted to offline panels
Search matches names without changing assignments
Connection filter includes offline panels and browser pages
A controlled reload targets the explicit page and stays locked while the request is open
Reload safeguards and progress remain visible with a cancellation action
Removing an offline panel uses the shared modal and blur styling
Cancelling removal leaves the panel and its assignment unchanged
Confirmed removal uses the existing deletion command and removes exactly one offline panel
Panel logs open in the same workspace with an exact page filter
Logs show all sources in newest order and render server messages as plain text
Repeated log updates preserve the open row and display the updated count
Device logs include multiple pages from the selected browser profile
Export retains the exact device filter and retrieves all bounded result pages
Severity filters update the query and displayed results
A delayed response from an earlier filter cannot restore obsolete log rows
Pausing logs keeps the displayed history and continues connection monitoring
Resuming the log view retrieves messages that arrived during the pause
Logs initially request and display only the newest 50 matching messages
Log search includes messages outside the first page
Loading older logs preserves open entries and uses an exclusive revision boundary
Live arrivals retain the chosen 100-message window
Loading history does not advance the live cursor past unseen arrivals or duplicate entries
A live burst beyond the transport cap fills the complete chosen window without gaps
Changing a filter rejects an older history response and resets its page size
A connection failure marks the data stale and disables remote actions
Reconnection restores live status and actions without replacing assignment inputs
Device workspace stays inside the viewport at 1920
Device workspace stays inside the viewport at 1440
Device workspace stays inside the viewport at 1024
Device workspace stays inside the viewport at 768
Device workspace stays inside the viewport at 390
Device workspace stays inside the viewport at 320
Log filters and messages fit a narrow viewport
Arrow keys switch tabs and move keyboard focus
Leaving for profile settings stops device polling and retains the document
